title: Indian Passport — Fresh Application (Normal vs Tatkaal)
authority: Ministry of External Affairs (CPV Division) / Passport Seva
verification_source: Ministry of External Affairs Revised Passport Fee Schedule (Effective July 1, 2026)
overview: Official process to apply for a fresh Ordinary Indian Passport under Normal or Tatkaal (expedited) scheme, including document requirements, fee structure, and Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) appointment procedures.
eligibility: Indian citizens above 18 years of age applying for a fresh passport. For Tatkaal: Applicant must not belong to restricted categories (such as major name change, citizenship by registration/naturalization, or adverse police records) and must provide mandatory verified identity proofs.

fees.amount: Normal (36 pages): ₹2,500.00 | Tatkaal (36 pages): ₹5,000.00 (60-page booklet: ₹3,500 Normal / ₹6,000 Tatkaal)
fees.breakdown: Fees revised effective July 1, 2026. Tatkaal includes standard processing fee plus ₹2,500 additional Tatkaal surcharge payable entirely during online appointment booking.
fees.payment_mode: Mandatory online payment through SBI e-Pay (Internet Banking, UPI, Credit/Debit Cards) on the official Passport Seva portal.

timeline.dispatch: Normal Scheme: Dispatched within 15 to 30 working days subject to clear police verification report. Tatkaal Scheme: Dispatched within 1 to 3 working days post PSK appointment (police verification conducted post-issuance).
timeline.delivery: Delivered strictly in-person to applicant at registered residential address via India Post Speed Post.

required_documents: Proof of Date of Birth (DoB): Birth Certificate issued by municipal authority OR Aadhaar Card / E-Aadhaar OR Matriculation / 10th Standard Marksheet / School Leaving Certificate.
Proof of Present Address: Aadhaar Card OR Active Bank Passbook with applicant's photo (scheduled public/private bank) OR Electricity/Water bill OR Voter ID (EPIC).
Non-ECR Proof (if applicable): 10th Standard passing certificate / Degree / Higher educational certificate.
For Tatkaal: Standard documents plus Annexure E (Self-Declaration for Tatkaal) and minimum 3 approved institutional photo identity proofs (e.g., Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, Service ID).
steps: Register on the official portal: https://www.passportindia.gov.in/ with your name and email ID.
Login and click on 'Apply for Fresh Passport / Re-issue of Passport'.
Select application type ('Fresh Passport'), scheme type ('Normal' or 'Tatkaal'), and booklet size ('36 Pages' or '60 Pages').
Fill in the applicant details, family details, present address, emergency contact, and previous passport details carefully.
Review the submitted form to ensure zero spelling errors matching your official identity documents.
Click 'Pay and Schedule Appointment' at your nearest Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK).
Complete online payment of the fee (₹2,500 for Normal 36p or ₹5,000 for Tatkaal 36p).
Print or save the appointment confirmation receipt with the ARN (Application Reference Number).
Visit the designated PSK/POPSK on the appointment date with original physical documents plus self-attested photocopies for biometric enrolment and document scrutiny.
warnings_and_fraud_prevention: Beware of fake lookalike websites (such as passport-seva.org, passportgov.in); the ONLY authentic portal is www.passportindia.gov.in ending in .gov.in.
Touting or using unauthorized travel agents for appointment booking is strictly discouraged by MEA; direct citizen booking is straightforward and transparent.
Suppression of existing criminal cases, dual nationality, or previous passport details is an offense under the Passports Act, 1967.
checklist: Verify spelling of your full name across all identity documents
Prepare original Proof of Address and Proof of Date of Birth + 2 sets of self-attested photocopies
Have online payment method ready (₹2,500 for Normal or ₹5,000 for Tatkaal)
Download and print Appointment Confirmation Receipt after scheduling
